discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and its development into therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology moved from basic discovery of the incretin hormone to transformative drugs (liraglutide, semaglutide) with very large clinical and public-health impact, including cardiovascular and renal benefits. The trio already won the 2024 Lasker-DeBakey Clinical Award and the 2024 Breakthrough Prize, a common precursor pattern for the Nobel, and the 2025 prize (regulatory T cells) leaves metabolic medicine open.
